description: Bitcoin only, beta. The BTC spot price, the trend, direction and confidence on each of thirteen timeframes with their consensus, the bull, base and bear cases with their probabilities for three horizons, and support and resistance by how often they recur. Direction and confidence only: no entry, target or stop is published. Every value carries its own observed time, and `freshness` says how old the snapshot is. Each horizon's inputs are judged at the moment of the answer, each series against its own cadence (judged_on[].cadence_check, and stale per input family; ETF flows by two days since their row was written, as stopped_refreshing judges them). Not investment advice.
